thread:
maya: quick flag  seeing a cluster of schema rejects on fncall routes showing up as billed tool runs. sample payload: ```json {
  "tool_call": { "name": "search", "args": ["q"] }
} ```

sam: can you paste the validator error?

maya: validator -> type_mismatch: expected object at /tool_call/args but got array

chris: right now routing marks these as fncall-reject and they fall through. billing counts the root invoke and later adapter sets a tag `tool_run_attempted` when it runs. if adapter never runs, attribution looks like a charged tool call.

sam: policy: do we bill pre-adapter schema rejects? my gut says no, but need audit-safe rule to prevent abuse.

chris: proposal: add internal metadata tags: `validation.outcome=reject_pre_adapter`, `validation.rule=shape_mismatch`, and set `billing.tool_executed=false` for those flows. record sample ids for auditing.

maya: Console UX should explicitly surface "Rejected before tool execution" with orange state and link to raw payload + sample id. Ops currently sees cost spike and opens pagers.

sam: rollout plan idea: (1) add internal route.meta.billing_hold, (2) canary 5% with billing_hold enabled, (3) sample rejected payloads for 30d, (4) monitor abuse signals and billing delta for 2w before flipping.

chris: implementation note: avoid changing public APIs. keep tags internal in route metadata and metrics. add unit/integration tests asserting `billing.tool_executed=false` when adapter did not run. include streaming fncall and partial-parse scenarios.

maya: also need a Console alert: when schema_rejects spike and billing increases within same 1h, auto-create a triage card showing top affected routes and sample payloads.

ops-bot: deploy: starting canary `invoke-validator-billing-hold` -> eng-runtime-canary (5%). CI green: 34 tests, 2 infra warnings. :rocket:

sam: i'll add metrics `validation.rejected_pre_adapter.sampled` and a runtime toggle for sampling. will open PR for telemetry + tests.

chris: i'll review the PR and make sure analytics team can reconcile billing. add e2e test that simulates adapter never called and verifies no tool charge tag.

maya: i'll open Console ticket with mockups for the new triage card and the rejected-state copy. will brief support with a short explainer to reduce escalations. tagging @console-ui for visibility. :thumbsup:
